messages.subject: Project Willow - Pennine Asset Finance consent
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Amelia,

The change-of-control consent from Pennine Asset Finance under the master hire agreement is a condition to completion. Could you let us know where the sellers have got to in obtaining it? We'd like it in hand well before the 16 May target.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
